record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly reduce Adam learning rate from 1e-3 to 7e-4 and increase dropout from 0.1 to 0.15. Slower updates coupled with stronger regularization may improve generalization of the normalized embeddings and recurrent states. Preserve all other settings, including embedding parameterization, GRU topology, causal readout, loss, history policy, seed 42, 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch. Train one model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly set Adam learning rate to 1.2e-3 and input dropout to 0.05. Lower dropout reduces input noise while the modestly higher learning rate accelerates adaptation. This explores a different configuration from the evaluated lower-learning-rate, higher-dropout trials. Preserve architecture, embedding parameterization, readout, loss, seeds, training limits and one checkpoint per category; existing predictor plumbing remains compatible.
